target: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters.

source: Amakhandidethi angathumela abameli ukuze babone zonke izingxenye zenqubo. Kusihlwa, amavoti abalwa amavolontiya abekwe iso elibukhali, alandela izinqubo ezithile.
target: Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.

target: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.

source: Isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusekelwe esiphuphuthekini kunobuchwepheshe bakudala obusekelwe kuyi-radar yaphansi ukuvumela abalawuli bezinto ezihamba emoyeni ukuthola indawo indiza ekuyo ngokunemba okukhulu nokunika abashayeli bezindiza ukwaziswa okunembe kakhudlwana.
target: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.

source: Azikho izinto zokuthutha ezibekwayo futhi izitimela ezihamba phezulu ngeke zime eWembli, futhi ukupaka izimoto kanye nezindawo zokupaka nokugibela azitholakali enkundleni.
target: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.

source: Ukwesaba kokungabi khona kwezinto zokuthutha kwenze ukuthi kube nokwenzeka ukuthi umdlalo uphoqelelwe ukudlalwa ngasese ngaphandle kwabathandi beqembu.
target: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.

source: Ucwaningo olushicilelwe ngoLwesine kumagazini weSayensi lubike ngokwakhiwa kwezinhlobo ezintsha zezinyoni eZiqhingini zase-Ecuadore eGalápagos.
target: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.

source: Ubacwaningi abavela eNyuvesi yasePrinceton eMelika kanye naseNyuvesi yase-Uppsala eSweden babike ukuthi izidalwa ezintsha ziziphendukele ngezizukulwane ezimbili kuphela, nakuba lenqubo bekukholelwa ukuthi ithatha isikhathi eside, ngenxa yokuzalela phakathi kwezintaka zika-Darwin ezitholakala kuleyo ndawo kuphela, ama-Geospiza fortes, kanye nezintaka ze-cactus ezithuthele lapho, ama-Geospiza conirostris.
target: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.

source: Igolide lingenziwa libe noma isiphi isibumbeko. Lingagingqwa libe yizibumbeko ezincane..
target: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.

source: Ingadonswa ibe ucingo oluncinyanyane, olungasontwa noma lulukwe. Lungabethelwa noma lugoqwe lube amashidi.
target: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.

source: Ingenziwa ibe lula, bese inamathiselwa kwenye insimbi. Ingenziwa ibe lula kangangokuthi kwesinye isikhathi yayisetshenziselwa ukuhlobisa izithombe ezidwetshwe ngesandla ezincwadini ezibizwa ngokuthi "illuminated manuscripts".
target: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".

source: Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-pH yekhemikhali. Ungenza inkomba ngokusebenzisa umhluzi weklabishi ebomvu.
target: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.

source: Ijusi yeklabishi ishintsha umbala kuye ngokuthi ikhemikhali ino-asidi noma i-alikhali engakanani.
target: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.

source: Izinga le-pH likhonjwa inani lama-ion weHydrogen (i-H kuyi-pH) kuyikhemikhali elihlolwayo.
target: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.

source: Ama-ion weHydrogen amaphrothoni lawo ekususwe ama-elektroni wawo kuwo (njengoba ama-athomu weHydrogen enziwa iphrothoni elilodwa kanye ne-elektroni elilodwa).
target: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).

source: Yaluzisa izimpuphu ezimbili ezomile bese, ngezandla ezihlanzekile ezimanzi, uzicindezele zibe yindingiliza.
target: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.

source: Umswakamo osezandleni zakho uzohlangana nongqimba olungaphandle, okuzoba nomuzwa oxakayo futhi kwenze uhlobo lwegobongo.
target: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.

source: Amadolobha waseHarappa kanye naseMohenjo-daro ayenedlu yangasese eshaywayo cishe kuzo zonke izindlu, ehlanganiswe nendlela eyinkimbinkimbi yokuthutha indle.
target: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.

source: Insalela yamapayipi athutha indle itholakele ezindlini zamadolobha wase-Minoan waseKhrithi nase-Santorini eGrisi.
target: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.

source: Zazikhona izindlu zangasese eGibhithe, ePheresiya, kanye naseShayina yamandulo. Empucukweni yaseRoma, izindlu zangasese kwesinye isikhathi kwakuyingxenye yezindlu zokugezela zomphakathi lapho abasilisa nabesifazana babehlangana ndawonye.
target: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.

source: Uma ushayela ucingo umuntu othile okude ngamamayela ayinkulungwane, usebenzisa isiphuphutheki.
target: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.

source: Isiphuphutheki esisemkhathini sithola ucingo bese siluthumela emuva ezansi, cishe ngaleso sikhathi.
target: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.

source: Isethilayithi ithunyelwe emkhathini kusentshenziswa i-rocket. Ososayensi basebenzise izibona kude ezisemkhathini ngoba umkhathi uphazamisa okunye kokukhanya kwethu kanye nokubona.
target: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.

source: Kudingeka irokhethi enkulu engaphezu kwamafidiangu-100 ukuphakama ukubeka isiphuphutheki noma ithelisikobho emkhathini.
target: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.

source: Isondo seliguqule umhlaba ngezindlela ezimangalisayo. Into enkulu ukuthi isondo elisenzele yona ukusinika indlela yokuthutha elula neshesha kakhulu.
target: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.

source: Isilethele isitimela, imoto, kanye nezinye izisetshenziswa zokuthutha.
target: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.

source: Ngaphansi kwazo kukhona amakati amancanyana ngobukhulu adla inyama ebanjelwa ukudliwakusuka kunogwaja kuya ezinyamazaneni.
target: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.

source: Ekugcineni, kunamakati amaningi amancane (kuhlanganise namakati afuywayo azizulelayo) adla izilwanyane ezizingelwayo eziningi kakhulu njengezinambuzane, izilwane eziququdayo, izibankwa, kanye nezinyoni.
target: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.

source: Imfihlo yempumelelo yabo umcabango wesikhundla, umsebenzi okhethekile ikati ngalinye elinawo olenza lingancintisani namanye.
target: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.

source: Amabhubesi angamakati anobudlelwane kakhulu, aphila ngamaqembu amakhulu abizwa ngokuthi umhlambi.
target: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.

source: Imihlambi yakhiwa iduna elilodwa noma amathathu ahlobene, ngokufanayo nezinsikazi ezintathu kanye namawundlu.
target: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.

source: Abesifazane ngokuvamile bahlobene, okuwumndeni omkhulu wodadewabo noma amadodakazi.
target: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.

source: Ivuyo lamabhubesi liziphatha njengomhlambi wamanketshane, izilwane ezifana namabhubesi ngokumangalisayo (kodwa hhayi amanye amakati amakhulu) ngokuziphatha, kanye futhi nokuba yingozi ezilwaneni ezizizingelayo.
target: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.

source: Umgadli ophelele, ihlosi lingakhuphuka (yize lingakwazi kahle), libhukude, ligxume amabanga amade futhi lidonse ngamandla womuntu onamandla aphindwe kasihlanu.
target: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.

source: Ithayiga lisesigabeni esifanayo (Genus Panthera) njengamabhubesi, izingwe, kanye nama-jaguar. Lawa makati amane yiwo kuphela akwazi ukubhonga.
target: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.

source: Ukubhonga kwehlosi akufani ncamashi nokubhonga kwengonyama, kodwa kucishe kufane nomusho wamagama entukuthelo, amenyezwayo.
target: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.

source: Amakati wasendle amakhulu waseMelika athanda ukudla izilwane ezincane. Azobamba izimfene, izinyoka, izilwane eziququdayo kanye nezinyoni uma angakwazi. Cishe zonke izilwane ezizingelwa yilawa makati zincane kakhulu kunawo.
target: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.

source: Ososayensi bakholelwa ukuthi amakati amakhulu waseMelika alandelela futhi athola izilwane zokuzidla (izilwane ezizingelwayo) ngokunuka, efufuza lapho bezikhona phansi.
target: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.

source: Ayakwazi ukubona kahle kakhulu ebumnyameni ngekhono lokubona ebusuku, abuye ahambe ngesinyenyela esikhulu, futhi. Ama-ocelot azingela izisulu zawo ngokuzifanisa nendawo akuyo bese agxumela izisulu zawo.
target: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.

source: Lapho iqembu elincane lezinto eziphilayo (inani elincane) lihlukana eqenjini elikhulu elisuka kulo (cishe lapho liya ngaphesheya kokhahlamba lwentaba noma umfula, noma uma liya esiqhingini esisha kangangokuba lingakwazi ukubuyela emuva kalula) ngokuvamile lizozithola endaweni ehlukile kunaleyo ebezikuyo ngaphambili.
target: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.

source: Le ndawo entsha inezinsizakusebenza ezihlukile nabancintisani abahlukene, ngakho-ke umphakathi omusha uzodinga izici ezihlukile noma ukuzivumelanisa nezimo ukuze ube ngabancintisani abaqinile kunalokho ababekudinga ngaphambilini.
target: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.

source: Izidalwa ezazikhona zasekuqaleni azikashintshi, zisadinga indlela yokuphila efana neyangaphambili.
target: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.

source: Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, njengoba iqembu elisha liqala ukujwayela indawo yalo entsha, liqala ukuya libukeka lingafani neqembu elinye.
target: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.

source: Ekugcineni, ngemva kweminyaka eyizinkulungwane noma ngisho eyizigidi, amaqembu amabili azobukeka ehlukile kangangokuba angeke abizwe ngokuthi uhlobo olulodwa.
target: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.

source: Sibiza lokhu kwenza ngokuthi ukwakheka, okushe nje ukwakhekha kwezinhlobo ezintsha. Lokhu kwakheka umphumela ongakwemeki kanye nengxenye ebaluleke kakhulu yokuziphendukela kwemvelo.
target: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.

source: Izitshalo zenza i-oxygen leyo ephefumulwa abantu, futhi zithatha i-carbon-dioxide leyo ekhishwa abantu (okungukuthi, ukuphefumula ukhiphe umoya).
target: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).

source: Izitshalo zenza ukudla kwazo nge-photosynthesis. Zibuye zenze nomthunzi.
target: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.

source: Senza izindlu zethu ngezitshalo futhi senza nezingubo ngezitshalo. Ukudla okuningi esikudlayo izitshalo. Ngaphandle kwezitshalo, izilwane angeke ziqhubeke ziphila.
target: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.

source: I-mosasaurus bekuyisilwane esizingelayo esiyinhloko ngesikhathi sayo, ngakho-ke yayingesabi lutho, ngaphandle kwama-mosasaurus amanye.
target: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.

source: Imihlathi yayo emide eyayihlome ngamazinyo acijise okwensingo angaphezu kuka-70, kanye namanye engeziwe phezu komlomo wayo, okusho ukuthi kwakungekho lutho esondela eduze kwayo eyayingaphunyuka.
target: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.

source: Asazi ngokuqinisekile, kodwa kungenzeka ukuthi yayinolimi olusamfoloko. Ukudla eyayikudla kuhlanganisa izimfudu, izinhlanzi ezinkulu, ama-mosasaurus amanye, futhi kungenzeka nokuthi yayiyizimu.
target: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.

source: Yayibuye ihlasele noma yini engena emanzini; ngisho ne-dinosaur enkulu njenge-T.rex yayingeke ikwazi ukumelana nayo.
target: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.

source: Ngenkathi iningi lokukudla kwabo kungaba okujwayelekile kuthina, amaRoma eyenesabelo sabo sezinto zemikhosi ezingajwayelekile, kubandakanya izingulube zasendle, ipigogo, iminenke, nohlobo lwegundane olubizwa nge-dormouse
target: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse

source: Omunye umehluko kwakuwukuthi nakuba abantu abampofu kanye nabesifazane babedla ukudla kwabo babe behlezi ezihlalweni, amadoda acebile ayethanda ukuba namadili ndawonye lapho ayehlala khona ngezinhlangothi kuyilapho edla ukudla kwawo.
target: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.

source: Ukudla kwaseRoma yamandulo kwakungeke kuhlanganise ukudla okufike eYurophu kuvela eMelika noma kuvela e-Asia emakhulwini eminyaka alandelayo.
target: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.

source: Ngokwesibonelo, babengenawo ummbila, noma otamatisi, noma amazambane, noma i-cocoa, futhi akekho umuntu waseRoma yamandulo oke wanambitha ikalikuni.
target: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.

source: AbaseBhabhiloni bakhela izithixo zabo ngazinye ithempeli eliyinhloko elalibhekwa njengekhaya lesithixo.
target: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.

source: Abantu abaletha imihlatshelo konkulunkulu nakubaphristi bazozama ukunika onkulunkulu izidingo zabo ngemigidi nemikhosi.
target: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.

source: Ithempeli ngalinye lalinegceke elivulekile lethempeli kanye nendawo engcwele ephakathi lapho kwakungena khona umphristi kuphela.
target: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.

source: Ngezinye izikhathi imibhoshongo ekhethekile engunxa-ntathu, ebizwa ngokuthi ama-ziggurat, yayakhiwe ukuze ibe ingxenye yamathempeli.
target: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.

source: Isiqongo sombhoshongo kwakuyindawo engcwele ekhethekile yesithixo.
target: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.

source: Esimweni sezulu esifudumele saseMpumalanga ePhakathi, indlu beyingabalulekanga kakhulu.
target: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.

source: Isikhathi esiningi impilo yemindeni yamaHebheru yenzeka endaweni evulekile.
target: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.

source: Owesifazane wayepheka egcekeni, izitolo kwakungamatafula avulwayo abheke emgwaqweni. Amatshe ayesetshenziselwa ukwakha izindlu.
target: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.

source: Ayengekho amahlathi amakhulu ezweni laseKhanani, ngakho izingodo zazibiza kakhulu.
target: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.

source: I-Greenland yayihlelwe kancane. E-Norse Segas bathi u-Erik the Red waboshwa e-Iceland ngenxa yokubulala, futhi lapho ehambela eNtshonalanga, wathola i-Greenland wase eyibiza ngokuthi i-Greenland.
target: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.

source: Kodwa naphezu kokuba etholakele, isizwe sama-Eskiro besilokhu sihlala lapho ngaleso sikhathi.
target: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.

source: Nakuba izwe ngalinye beliyi-‘Scandinavian’, bekunokungefani okuningi phakathi kwabantu, amakhosi, amasiko, kanye nomlando wase-Denmark, e-Sweden, e-Norway kanye nase-Iceland.
target: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.

source: Uma wake wayibuka imovie i-National Treasure, ungafunga ukuthi ibalazwe lomcebo lalibhalwe ngemuva kweSimemezelo Sokuzimela.
target: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.

source: Noma kunjalo, lokho akulona iqiniso. Noma kunokuthile okubhalwe ngemuva kwencwadi, akuyona imephu eyigugu.
target: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.

source: Okubhalwe ngemuva eNcazelweni Yokuzimela bekungamazwi “ENcazelo Yokuqala Yokuzimela yangomhlaka-4 Julayi 1776”. Umbhalo ovela ekugcineni kwencwadi, obheke phansi.
target: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.

source: Yize kungekho owaziyo ngokuqinisekile ukuthi ngubani oyibhalile, kuyaziwa ukuthi ekuqaleni kokuphila kwayo, idokhumenti yesikhumba (inobukhulu obungamayintshi angu-29¾ ngamayintshi angu-24½) yayisongwa ukuze igcinwe.
target: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.

source: Ngakho-ke, cishe umcabango wafakwa njengophawu kalula.
target: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.

source: Ukufika kwamabutho Ahlangene kanye nezimpi ezalandela zakhulula inyakatho yeFulansi, kodwa iningizimu yayingakakhululeki.
target: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.

source: Yayibuswa amaFulentshi wase-“Vinchy”. Laba bekungabantu baseFulansi ababenze ukuthula neJalimane ngo-1940 futhi besebenzisana nabaphangi esikhundleni sokuthi balwe nabo.
target: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.

source: Ngo-15 Agusti 1940, Izivunani zahlasela iningizimu France, futhi ukuhlasela kwabizwa “Umsebenzi Dragoon”.
target: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".

source: Ngamasonto amabili nje amasosha ase-Melika kanye nawase-French Ekhululekile akhiphe iningizimu France ezingxoxweni zokuhweba futhi asephendukela eJalimane
target: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.

source: Umphakathi wesintu isiko elilodwa elihlanganyelwa iqembu elikhulu labantu abahla futhi basebenze ndawonye, umphakathi.
target: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.

source: Igama elithi civilization lisuka egameni lesiLatin elithi civilis, okusho impucuko, elihlobene nelesiLatin elithi civis, elisho isakhamuzi, kanye nelithi civitas, elisho idolobha noma isifundazwe, futhi lokho ngenye indlela kubuye kuchaze ubukhulu bomphakathi.
target: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.

source: Izifundazwe zandulela izizwe. Isiko lomphakathi lisho ukudlulisela ulwaze ezizukulwaneni eziningana, umkhondo ongokwesiko ohlala ukhona kanye nokusakazwa okuhle kokwaziswa.
target: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.

source: Amasiko amancane ngokuvamile ayanyamalala ngaphandle kokushiya ubufakazi obungokomlando futhi ayahluleka ukuqashelwa njengemiphakathi yangempela.
target: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.

source: Phakathi neMpi Yezinguqugo, izifunda eziyishumi nantathu zaqala zakha uhulumeni obuthakathaka—uKhongolose kuyisici sawo sodwa—ngaphansi kwe-Articles of Confederation.
target: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.

source: Ukhongolose wabe engenawo amandla okubeka intela, futhi, ngenxa yokuthi bokungekho sigungu sezwe noma noma isigungu sokwahlulela, uncike ezikhulwini zombuso, ezazingabambisani izikhathi ezingi, ukuphoqelela yonke imithetho yawo.
target: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.

source: Yayingenalo futhi igunya lokweqa imithetho yentela nokuthelisa ngempahla phakathi kwezifunda.
target: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.

source: Imithetho beyidinga ukuba zonke izifunda zivume ngaphambi kokuba ilungiswe futhi izifunda zithathe uhulumeni omkhulu njengongabalulekile kakhulu kangangokuba abameleli bazo babehlala bangekho.

source: Ibhola lezinyawo lezwe laseNtaliyane, kanye neqembu lebhola lezinyawo lezwe laseJalimane iqembu lesibili eliphumelele kakhulu emhlabeni futhi bekuyizingqwele zeNdebe yoMhlaba yeFIFA ngo-2006.

source: Ijapani ineziqhingi ezicishe zibe ngu-7000 (esikhulu kunazo zonke iHonshu), okwenza iJapani isiqhingi sesi-7 esikhulu kunazo zonke emhlabeni!

source: Ukusungulwa kweTaiwan kuqala kudala ngekhulu lama-15 leminyaka lapho amatilosi aseYurophu edlula ebhala igama lesiqhingi ngokuthi i-Ilha formosa, noma isiqhingi esihle.

source: Ngo1624,inkampani yaseNdiya yeDutch East yamisa isikhungo eningizimu ntshonalanga Taiwan, iqalisa ukushintshwa kokukhiqizwa kokusanhlamvu komdabu futhi iqasha izisebenzi zaseShayina ukuba zisebenze emasimini welayisi noshukela.
target: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.

source: Ngo-1683, amabutho obukhosi buka-Qing (1644-1912) athatha izindawo ezingasogwini ezisentshonalanga nasenyakatho ne-Taiwan futhi amisa i-Taiwan njengesifundazwe sombuso ka-Qing ngo-1885.
target: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.

source: Ngo-1895, ngemva kokuhlulwa eMpini Yokuqala yamaJapani yase—ino (1894-1895), uhulumeni wase-Qing usayina Isivumelwano se-Simonoseki, ngaso edlulisela iTaiwan eJapani, ebusa isiqhingi kuze kube ngu-1945.
target: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.

source: IMachu Picchu yenziwa izakhiwo ezintathu eziyinhloko, okungukuthi i-Intihuatana, i-Temple of the Sun, kanye ne-Room of the Three Windows.
target: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.

source: Izakhiwo eziningi onqenqemeni lwendawo yokuhlala zakhiwe kabusha ukuzi zinikeze izivakashi umqondo ongcono wendlela ezazibukeka ngayo ekuqaleni.
target: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.

source: Ngo-1976, amaphesenti angamashumi amathathu weMachu Picchu ayebuyiselwe esimweni sasekuqaleni futhi ukubuyiselwa kusaqhubeka kuze kube namuhla.
target: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.

source: Ngokwesibonelo, indlela evamile kakhulu yohlobo lwesithombe emhlabeni ingu-35mm, ewubukhulu obufanayo nobefilimu ekupheleni kwesiqephu senkathi yamafilimu.
target: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.

source: Isenziwa nanamuhla, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi ubudlelwane bayo bobude nobukhulu buthathwe izimo zokuthungatha isithombe zekhamera yedijithali.
target: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.

source: Ifomethi ka-35mm empeleni, ngodidayo ngokunye, ingu-36mm ububanzi kuphindwe ngo-24mm ubude.
target: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.

source: Isilinganiso sobubanzi ebudeni salefomethi (ukudivayida ngeshumi nambili ukuze uthole isilinganiso senombolo ephelele elula) ngakho-ke kuthiwa singu-3:2.
target: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.

source: Amafomethi amaningi avamile (iqoqo lamafomethi le-APS, ngokwesibonelo) ayalingana noma acishe alingane nalesi silinganiso sobubanzi ebudeni.
target: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.

source: Lomthetho wezingxenye ezintathu esetshenziswa kabi kakhulu nonganakwa ngokuvamile isiqondiso esilula sokwenza ubuhle ube ugcina izinga lokuhleleka esithombeni.
target: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.

source: Ithi indawo ephumelela kakhulu ngesihloko esikhulu ilapho imigqa ihlangana khona ukuze ihlukanise isithombe kathathu ngokuqondile nangokuvundlile (bheka isibonelo).
target: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).

source: Phakathi nalenkathi yomlando waseYurophu, iSonto lamaKatolika, elalicebile futhi linamandla, lahlolisiswa.
target: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.

source: Ngaphezu kweminyaka eyinkulungwane inkolo yobuKhristu yahlanganisa amazwe waseYurophu ndawonye ngaphezu kokuhluka kwezilimi namasiko.
target: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I

source: Amandla waso akuyo yonke indawo athinta wonke umuntu kusukela enkosini kuya emuntwini ovamile.
target: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.

source: Enye yemigomo eyinhloko yobuKristu ukuthi ingcebo kufanele isetshenziselwe ukudambisa ukuhlupheka nobuphofu nokuthi imali yebandla ilapho ngenxa yaleso sizathu.
target: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.

source: Abaphathi abakhulu besonto babeseRoma iminyaka engaphezu kwenkulungwane futhi lokhu kuqoqana kwamandla nemali kwaholela abaningi ekusoleni ukuthi lomgomo wemfundiso uyafinyelelwa yini.
target: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.

source: Ngokushesha ngemva kobutha, iBrithani yaqala ukuvimbezela iJalimane ngemikhumbi.
target: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.

source: Isu libonakale lisebenza, ukususwa kwezinto ezidingwa ibutho lamasosha nabantu abavamile, nakuba lokhu kuvimbela kuphule imithetho yamazwe wonke elungiswe izivumelwano zamazwe amaningana wamakhulu amabili eminyaka adlule.
target: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.

source: I-Britain imba amanzi ezwekazi ukuze ivimbele imikhumbi ukuthi ingene kuyo yonke ingxenye yolwandle, okubangela izingozi ngisho nasemikhunjini evamile.
target: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.

source: Njengoba bekunokusabela okulinganiselwe kulendlela, iJalimane beyilindele ukusabela okufanayo empini yayo engavinjelwe yemikhumbi yangaphansi kwamanzi.
target: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.

source: Ngezikhathi zawo-1920, izimo zengqondo zezakhamuzi eziningi kanye nezizwe bezikholwa ukuzonda impi nokulwa kanye nokuzihlukanisa.
target: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.

source: Ngemva kokubona izenzo zonya nezishaqisayo zempi phakathi neMpi Yezwe I, izizwe zafisa ukugwema isimo esinjalo futhi esikhathini esizayo.
target: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.

source: Ngo-1884 uTesla wathuthela eMelika ukwamukela umsebenzi neNkampani ka-Edison eDolobheni lase-New York.
target: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.

source: Ufike eMelika enamasenti angu-4 kuphela, incwadi yezinkondlo, kanye nencwadi yokutusa evela ku-Charles Batchelor (umphathi wakhe wasemsebenzini wakhe wangaphambili) iya kuThomas Edison.
target: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.

source: IShayina yamandulo yayinendlela ehlukile yokuveza izinkathi ezihlukile; isigaba ngasinye seShayina noma umndeni ngamunye owawubusa wawuwubukhosi obuhlukile.
target: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.

source: Futhi phakathi kobukhosi ngabunye kwakuyiminyaka engazinzile yezifundazwe ezihlukene. Inkathi eyaziwa kakhulu kulezi kwakuyinkathi yemibuso emithathu eyenzeka iminyaka engama-60 phakathi koMbusokaHan noJin.
target: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.

source: Phakathi nalesi sikhathi kwakuba nezimpi ezinodlame phakathi kwababusi belwela ubukhosi.
target: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.

source: IMibuso Emithathu kwakungenye yenkathi yegazi eliningi kunazo zonke emlandweni waseShayina yakuDala, izinkulungwane zabantu zafa zilwela ukuhlala esihlalweni esiphakeme kakhulu esigodlweni esihle e-Xi’an.
target: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.

source: Kunemiphumela eminingi yezenhlalo neyezepolitiki efana nokusetshenziswa kohlelo lokulinganisa ngamamitha, ukusuka ekukholelweni ezimisweni eziphelele kuya ekusekeleni izimiso zoburiphabhuliki, ubuzwe kanye nenkolelo yokuthi izwe elabantu hhayi umbusi oyedwa.
target: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.

source: Futhi ngemva kweNguquko izikhundla zazivulekele bonke abesilisa abafake izicelo okwavumela ukuthi abafuna ukuvelela kakhulu nokubahambela kahle baphumelele.
target: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.

source: Lokhu kufana nalokhu okwenzeka kumabutho amasosha kunokuba babheke inhlanga yakho bona bakhetha ukubeka i-cailaber ukuze banike amasosha ama-ratings.
target: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.

source: Ukuvukela kwaseFulansi kugqugquzele abanye abantu abasebenzayo abacindezelwe bakwamanye abazwe ukuthi baqale ukuvukela kwabo.
target: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.

source: UMuhammad wayenesithakazelo esijulile ezindabeni zokuphila ezingaphathelene nezinto zalomhlaba. Wayevame ukuya emhumeni owaziwa ngokuthi “iHira” eNtabeni “yeNoor” (ukukhanya) ukuze ayozindla.
target: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
