source: Umhume ohlezi phezu kwenye yezintaba zasenyakatho yase-Mecca, ukude kakhulu nomhlaba wonke.
target: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.

source: Eqinisweni, akulula ukuyithola ngisho noma wazi ukuthi ikhona. Uma isingaphakathi emhumeni isuke isihlukaniswe ngokuphelele.
target: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.

source: Akukho okubonakalayo phezulu ngaphandle kwesibhakabhaka esibalele, esihle kanye nezintaba eziningi ezizungezile. Kuncane kakhulu okwalelizwe okubonakalayo noma okuzwakalayo uma uphakathi emgedeni.
target: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.

source: I-Great Pyramid yase-Giza iyokuphela kwizimangaliso eziyisikhombisa esamile nanamuhla.
target: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.

source: Yakhiwe ngabaseGibhithe ngekhulu lesithathu leminyaka BCE, iPhiramidi eliKhulu ngelinye lezakhiwo zamaphiramidi ezakhelwe ukuhlonipha uFaro oshonile.
target: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.

source: IThafa Eliphakeme laseGiza, noma “iGiza Necropolis” eSigodini sabaFile saseGibhithe linemibhoshongo emingxa-ntathu eminingana (leyo umbhoshongo omkhulu kuyiwo omkhulu kakhulu), amathuna amaningana amancane, amathempeli amaningana, kanye ne-Sphinx enkulu.
target: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.

source: Umbhoshongo omkhulu ongunxa-ntathu wakhelwe ukuhlonipha uFaro uKhufu, futhi neminye imibhoshongo engunxa-ntathu emincanyana, amathuna, kanye namathempeli akhelwe ukuhlonipha inkosikazi kaKhufu kanye namalungu omndeni.
target: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.

source: Uphawu "lokukhothama umile" olubukeka njengo-V kanti "uphawu lokukhothama phansi" lubukeka njengesigaxa noma isikwele esishoda ngohlangothi lwaso olungaphansi.
target: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.

source: Phezulu kusho ukuthi kumelwe uqale ekugcineni bese uphusha umcibisholo, kanti phansi kusho ukuthi kumelwe uqale exoxweni (okusho ukuthi lapho ubambe khona umcibisholo) bese ugobisa umcibisholo.
target: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.

source: Umnsalo ophezulu ujwayele ukwenza umsindo opholile, kanti umnsalo ophansi wenza umsindo onamandla noqinile kakhudlwana.
target: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.

source: Zizwe ukhululekile ukubhala izimpawu zakho ngepensela, kepha khumbula izimpawu eziphrintiwe ezehlayo zikhona ngesizathu esingokomculo, ngakho-ke kufanele zihlonishwe.
target: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.

source: Inkosi uLouis XVI ethukile, iNdlovukazi uMarie Antoinette kanye nezingane zabo ezincane ezimbili (uMarie Therese oneminyaka engu-11 ubudala kanye noLouis-Charles eneminyaka emine ubudala) kanye nodadewabo weNkosi, iNkosazana u-Elizabeth, ngomhla ka-6 Okthoba 1789 baphoqelelwa ukubuyela eParis besuka eVersailles uquqaba lwabesifazane basemakethe.
target: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.

source: Besenkalishini, babuyela emuva ePherisi bezungezwe uquqaba lwabantu oluklabalasa kanye nokumemeza izinsongo ngokumelene neNkosi kanye neNdlovukazi.
target: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.

source: Isixuku sabantu siphoqelele iNkosi kanye neNdlovukazi ukuba bavule kakhulu amafasitela esithuthi sabo.
target: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.

source: Kunesikhathi lapho ilungu loquqaba lalifuna ukunqathuzisa ikhanda lonogada wasebukhosini obulawe eVersailles phambi kweNdlovukazi ethukile.
target: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.

source: Izindleko zempi zobukhosi baseMelika lapho inqoba iPhilippines zakhokhelwa abantu basePhilippines ngokwabo.
target: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.

source: Baphoqelelwa ukukhokhela intela umbuso wobukoloni waseMelika ukukhokha ingxenye enkulu yezindleko futhi inzalo yamabhondi yabekwa egameni likahulumeni wasePhilippines ngezindlu zasebhange zeWall Street.
target: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.

source: Kusobala, izinzuzo ezinkulu ezitholwe ngokuxhaphazwa okungapheli kwabantu baseFilipino benza izinzuzo eziyisisekelo zobukhosi baseMelika.
target: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.

source: Ukuze uqonde amaTemplar umuntu kufanele aqonde umcabango owadala le nhlangano.
target: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.

source: Inkathi lapho kube nesehlakalo khona ivame ukubhekiselwa ngokuthi Inkathi Ephakathi Ephezulu inkathi yomlando waseYurophu ngekhulu lama-11, lama-12, kanye nelama-13 leminyaka (AD 1000–1300).
target: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).

source: IHigh Middle Ages yandulelwa i-Early Middle Ages futhi yase ilandelwa iLate Middle Ages, ngokwenjwayelo iphela ngabo ends around 1500.
target: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.

source: Inkolelo yokumiselwa okungokwezobuchwepheshe igama elihlanganisa imibono eminingi esebenzayo, kusukela ekusebenziseni ezobuchwepheshe ezikhona noma ekutheni ezobuchwepheshe ziyadingeka kuya emuzweni oqinile wokuthi ukumiselwa kwesintu kuholwa umcabango ojulile ohlobene nemithetho yesayensi nokubonakala kwayo kwezobuchwepheshe.
target: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.

source: Izincazelo eziningi zenkolelo yokumiselwa okungokwezobuchwepheshe buhlanganyela imibono emibili evamile: ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe ngokwakho kulandela indlela engaphezu kwethonya lesiko noma lepolotiki kakhulu, kanye nokuthi ezobuchwepheshe nazo "zinethonya" emiphakathini ezuzwayo ngokwemvelo, kunangezimo zenhlalo.
target: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.

source: Ngokwesibonelo, othile angathi imoto iholela ekwakhiweni kwemigwaqo.
target: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.

source: Nokho, imigwaqo exhumanisa izwe lonke ayizuzisi ngokomnotho ezimotweni ezimbalwa nje kuphela, ngakho izindlela ezintsha zokukhiqiza ziyenziwa ukunciphisa inani lokuba nemoto.
target: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.

source: Ukuba nezimoto kwabantu abaningi nakho kuholela ezigamekweni eziphakeme zezingozi emigwaqweni, okuholela ekusungulweni kwezindlela ezintsha kwezempilo zokulungisa imizimba elimele.
target: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.

source: Ezothando zinomthelela omkhulu ezinkolelweni zokuziphatha zamasiko, okuthathelwa kubabhali abanjengoGoethe, uFichte, kanye noSchlegel.
target: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.

source: Esizindeni seRomanticism, indawo ibumba abantu ngabanye, futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi imikhuba nesiko ehlobene naleyo ndawo yavela, futhi lena, ivumelana nendawo yomphakathi, yayingcono kunemithetho emiswe ngokunganaki.
target: In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.

source: Ngendlela iParis eyaziwa ngayo njengenhlokodolobha yezwe lamanje, iConstantinople yayibhekwa njengenhlokodolobha yezikhonzi zaseYurophu.
target: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.

source: Yaziwa ngokuba yindawo yalapho kwaqala khona izinto zikanokusho cishe ngo-400 A.D. futhi yahlala cishe kwaze kaba u-1100 A.D.
target: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.

source: Isimo sayo sawohloka phakathi nekhulu leminyaka leshumi nambili ngokuyinhloko ngenxa yokuthi Abalweli Benkolo babebuye bephethe izipho ezinjengosilika nezinongo ezaziyigugu kunalezo imakethe yaseByzantium eyayinazo.
target: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.

source: Kwakungalesi sikhathi lapho ukudluliselwa kwesiqu seNhlokodolobha yeMfashini kusuka eKhonstantinopheli kuya ePherisi kwenziwa.
target: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.

source: Isitayela sobuGothiki sakhula ngenkathi ephakathi kwamakhulu weminyaka wama-10 -11 nekhulu leminyaka lama-14.
target: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.

source: Ekuqaleni ukwembatha kwakuthonywe kakhulu isiko laseByzantium empumalanga.
target: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.

source: Noma kunjalo, ngenxa yokungabi khona kwezindlela zokuxhumana, izitayela zasentshonalanga zingasalela emuva ngeminyaka ewu-25 ukuya kwengu-30.
target: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.

source: Ngasekupheleni kweNkathi Ephakathi intshonalanga Yurophu yaqala ukuthuthukisa isitayela sayo. Enye yentuthuko enkulu kakhulu yaleso sikhathi ngenxa yabalweli benkolo abantu baqala ukusebenzisa izinkinobho ukubopha izimpahla zokugqoka.
target: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.

source: Ukulimela ukuziphilisa ukulima okwenzelwa ukukhiqiza ukudla okwanele ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomlimi kanye nomdeni wakhe kuphela.
target: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.

source: Ukulimela ukuziphilisa indlela elula, ngovamile okususelwe ezintweni eziphilayo, kusetshenziswa imbewu egciniwe yasendaweni enezici ezingokwemvelo kuhlanganiswe nokushintshashintsha izilimo noma ezinye izindlela ezilula zokwenza umkhiqizo ube mningi.
target: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.

source: Ngokomlando abalimi abaningi babelimela ukuziphilisa futhi kusenjalo emazweni amaningi athuthukayo.
target: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.

source: Amaqembu ahlukile ahlanganisa abantu abazizwa benganakiwe yizimiso zomphakathi futhi abavumela ukwakha umuzwa wobuntu babo.
target: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.

source: Amasiko angaba ahlukanisayo ngenxa yeminyaka, uhlanga, isizinda, indawo, kanye/noma ubulili bamalungu.
target: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.

source: Izici eziveza iqembu elinyingxenye yesiko njengelihlukile kungaba ulimi, ubuhle, inkolo, ipolotiki, ubulili, indawo, noma inhlanganisela yezici.
target: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.

source: Amalungu weqembu eliyingxenye yesiko avamise ukubonakalisa ubulungu bawo ngokusebenzisa isitayela esihlukile nesimelela okuthile, esihlanganisa imfashini, ukuziphatha, kanye nendlela yokukhuluma.
target: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.

source: Enye yezindlela eziningi kwezivamile ezisentshenziswa ukuchaza ukubaluleka kokuhlalisana nabanye ukusondelana nabambalwa ezinganeni, okwathi ngokunganakwa, ngeshwa, noma ngokuhlukunyezwa ngamabomu, bangajwayelaniswa nabantu abadala ngesikhathi besakhula.
target: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.

source: Izingane ezinjalo zibizwa ngokuthi “zinobulwane” noma ezasendle. Ezinye izingane ezinobulwane zigcinwe abanye abantu (ngokuvamile abazali bazo); kwezinye izimo lokhu kulahlwa kwezingane kwakungenxa yokungamukeli komzali ukukhubazeka okukhulu ngokwengqondo noma ngokomzimba kwengane.
target: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.

source: Izingane ezinobulwane kungenzeka ukuthi zihlangabezane nokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane okubi noma ukucindezeleka ngaphambi kokulahlwa noma ukubaleka.
target: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.

source: Ezinye kuthiwa zikhuliswe izilwane; ezinye kuthiwa zihlale endle zizodwa.
target: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.

source: Lapho ikhuliswe ngokuphelele isilwane ekungesona umuntu, ingane enobulwane iveza ukuziphatha (ngokulinganiselwa okungokoqobo) cishe okufana ngokuphele nokwesilwane ebesiyinakekela, njengokusaba noma ukungabi nandaba nabantu.
target: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.

source: Nakuba ukufunda okusekelwe kuyiphrojekthi kumelwe kwenze ukufunda kube lula futhi kuthakazelise kakhudlwana, izibhaxa zenza okwengeziwe.
target: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.

source: I-scaffolding akuyona indlela yokufunda kodwa kunalokho insiza enikeza usizo kubantu ngabanye abafunda okusha njengokusebenzisa uhlelo olusha lwekhompyutha noma ukuqala iphrojekthi entsha.
target: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.

source: Ama-Scaffolds angaba wekhompyutha futhi abe ngokoqobo, ngamanye amagama, uthisha uwuhlobo lwe-scaffold kodwa kunjalo nangomuntu omncane wocingo lokuhlanganisa amaphepha kuyi-Microsoft Office.
target: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.

source: Izibhaxa zekhompyutha zifakwe phakathi kohlelo lokusebenza futhi zenzelwe ukubuza, ukushukumisa, kanye nokuchaza izinqubo okungenzeka ukuthi bekunzima ukuthi abafundi basebenze ngazo bebodwa.
target: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.

source: Izingane zigcinwa emakhaya anakekela abantwana ngezizathu eziningi njengokukhishwa inyumbazane, ukuhlukunyezwa kanye nokuphamba.
target: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.

source: Kayikho ingane okufanele ikhule endaweni engalungile, engenalo uthando, engenankathalo kanye nemfundo, kodwa kuyenzeka.
target: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.

source: Sikholelwa ukuthi Uhlelo Lokutholwa Kwezingane luzoba yindawo yokuphepha yalezi zingane.
target: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.

source: Inqubo yethu yokuthola abantwana abangenabazali kumelwe ihlinzeke ngamakhaya aphephile, abanakekeli abanothando, imfundo ezinzile, kanye nezokwelapha ezinokwethenjelwa.
target: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.

source: Ikhaya lezintandane kumelwe lihlinzeke ngezidingo ezazingatholakali ekhaya abathathwe kulo ngaphambili.
target: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.

source: I-Inthanethi ihlanganisa izici zokukhulumisana kweningi nokokusebenzelana nabanye.
target: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.

source: Izici ezihlukile ze-Inthanethi zaholela ebubanzini obengeziwe uma kukhulunywa ngendlela yokusebenzisa nokwaneliseka.
target: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.

source: Ngokwesibonelo, "ukufunda" kanye "nokuzihlanganisa nomphakathi" kusikiselwa njengezisusa ezibalulekile zokusbenzisa i-Inthanethi (James et al., 1995).
target: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).

source: "Ukuhlanganyela komuntu siqu" kanye "nobudlelwane obuqhubekayo" kubuywe kwavezwa njengezici ezintsha zesisusa ngu-Eighmey noMcCord (1998) lapho behlola indlela yokusabela yababukele amawebhusayithi.
target: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.

source: Ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lwevidiyo kuholele kukwazisa okubalulekile ekuchazweni kokuziveza okuncane kakhulu, ukunyakaza kobuso okuthatha imizuzwana.
target: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.

source: Ikakhulu, kuthiwa umuntu angabona ukuthi umuntu uqamba amanga ngokuchachisa izibonakaliso zobuso ezincane ngokunembile.
target: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.

source: U-Oliver Sack ephepheni lakhe lNkulumo kaMongameli, uphawule ukuthi abantu okunzima ngabo ukuqonda inkulumo ngenxa yokulimala engqondweni bayakwazi ukubona ubuqotho ngokunembile.
target: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.

source: Futhi usikisele nokuthi amakhono anjalo wokuchaza indlela yokuziphatha yabantu angahlanganyelwa nezilwane ezinjengezinja ezifuywayo.
target: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.

source: Ucwaningo lwangekhulu lamashumi amabili leminyaka libonise ukuthi kunezigaba ezimbili zokuhluka: okufihliwe nokuveziwe.
target: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.

source: Ukuguquka kwenza ukwahluka kwezakhi zofuzo okusha, futhi ukukhetha kuzisusa emehlukweni oveziwe.
target: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.

source: Ukwehluka kokuhlukaniswa nokuhlanganiswa kwehla kwenyuke phakathi kwezigaba ezimbli ngesizukulwane ngasinye.
target: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.

source: Ngaphandle emahlathini, kunzima ngesilwane esinesimiso sokugaya ukudla esifana nesabantu ukwanelisa imfuneko yaso yama-amino-acid ngezitshalo ezikhona.
target: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.

source: Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhluleka ukwenza kanjalo kunemiphumela emibi kakhulu: ukungakhuli kahle, ukungondleki, kanye nokufa ngaphambi kwesikhathi.
target: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.

source: Imithombo yezitshalo etholakala kalula ngabe ngamaprotheni atholakala emaqabungeni nasezindimeni, kepha lezi zilukhuni kohlobo lokuqala njengathi ukugaya ngaphandle kokuthi luphekwe.
target: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.

source: Ngokuphambene, ukudla kwezilwane (izintuthwane, umuhlwa, amaqanda) akugayeki kalula nje kuphela, kodwa kunikeza amaphrotheni asezingeni eliphezulu anama-amino acid adingekayo.
target: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.

source: Lapho zonke izinto sezicatshangelwe, akumelwe simangale uma okhokho bethu bazixazululela bona “inkinga yamaphrotheni“ ngendlela ecishe ifane neyezimfene ethafeni namuhla.
target: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.

source: Ukuphazamiseka kokulala inqubo yokuvuka ngenhloso phakathi nesikhathi sakho sokulala esivamile nokuzumeka futhi ngokushesha ngemva kwalokho (imizuzu engu-10–60).
target: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).

source: Lokhu kungenziwa kalula ngokusebenzisa iwashi elikhalayo elikhalela phansi uma kulinganiswa ukuze likusangulukise ngaphandle kokukuphaphamisa ngokugcwele.
target: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.

source: Uma uzithola usetha kabusha iwashi ube ulele lapho uphethwe ubuthongo, lingabekwa kolunye uhlangothi lwekamelo, okukuphoqa ukuba uphume embhedeni ukuze ulicime.
target: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.

source: Ezinye izindlela ezisekelwe emjikelezweni ongokwemvelo zihlanganisa ukuphuza uketshezi oluningi (ikakhulukazi amanzi noma itiye, umuthi ochamisayo owaziwayo) ngaphambi kokulala, okuphoqa umuntu ukuba avuke ayochama.
target: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.

source: Inani lokuthula kwangaphakathi umuntu akutholayo lihlangana ngokuhlukene nenani lokucindezeleka emzimbeni womuntu kanye nasemoyeni.
target: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.

source: Lapho ukucindezeleka kuphansi, kuyilapho amandla okuphila akhona eba mahle kakhulu. Wonke umuntu angakwazi ukuthola ukuthula okuphelele kanye nokwaneliseka.
target: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.

source: Wonke umuntu angaphumelela. Okuwukuphela kwento ema endleleni yokufinyelela lo mgomo isimo sethusenqondo kanye nokuzenyeza.
target: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.

source: UbuBhuda base-Tibet busekelwe ezimfundisweni zikaBhuda, kodwa zandiswa indlela yothando yobu-mahayana nayizinqubo eziningi ezisuka kuyiYoga yaseNdiya.
target: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.

source: Ngokuyisisekelo ubuBuddha baseTibet bulula kakhulu. Buhlanganisa iKundalini Yoga, ukuzindla kanye nendlela yothando olwamukela konke.
target: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.

source: Nge-Kundali Yoga amandla e-Kundali (amandla okukhanyisa) avuselelwa ngokuzivocavoca ngohlobo lwe-yoga, ukuzivocavoca kokuphefumula, amazwi aphindwaphindwayo kanye nokubona ngeso lengqondo.
target: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.

source: Isikhungo sokuzindla kwase-Tibet iYoga yesiThixo. Ngokubona ngeso lengqondo izithixo ezahlukahlukene imizila yamandla iba ehlanzekile, ama-chakra enziwa ukuthi asebenze futhi ukukhanya kokubakhona kuyakhiwa.
target: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.

source: Ijalimane bekuyisitha esivamile eMpini Yezwe 2, okwaholela ekusebenzisaneni phakathi kwe-USSR kanye neMelika. Ngokuphela kwempi ukungqubuzana kwezimiso, izinqubo kanye namasiko kwaholela ekubeni amazwe axabane.
target: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.

source: Ngemva kweminyaka emibili yempi, ababeyimifela ndawonye empini manje sebeyizitha futhi sebeqalise Impi Ebandayo.
target: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.

source: Kwakufanele ihlale iminyaka engu-40 elandelayo futhi kulwe kuyo ngokoqobo, amabutho abambele, ezinkundleni zempi kusukela e-Afrika kuya e-Asia, e-Afghanistan, eCuba kanye nakwezinye izindawo eziningi.
target: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.

source: NgoSepthemba 17, 1939, amabutho avikelayo wasePoland wayehlaselwe kakade, futhi ukuphela kwethemba kwakuwukuhlehla nokuhlela kabusha eceleni kwesihloko saseRomaniya.
target: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.

source: Nokho, lezi zinhlelo zaphelelwa yisikhathi cishe ngobusuku obubodwa, lapho amasosha angaphezu kuka-800,000 asuka kuyiSoviet's Union Red Army engena akha amabutho waseBelarussia kanye ne-Ukraine ngemva kokuhlasela izindawo ezingasempumalanga zasePoland ephula Isivumelwano Sokuthula seRiga, i-Soveiet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, kanye nezinye izivumelwane zamazwe onke zokuthula, kokubili zezizwe ezinxa-mbili kanye neziningi.
target: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.

source: Ukusebenzisa imikhumbi ukuthutha impahla yindlela ephumelela kakhulu yokuthutha abantu abaningi kanye nempahla ngaphesheya kwezilwandle.
target: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.

source: Umsebenzi wamatilosi ngokujwayelekile kwakungukuqinisekisa ukuthi izwe lakho ligcina ikhono lokuhambisa abantu bakho nempahla, kuyilapho ngesikhathi esifanayo, ephazamisa ikhono lesitha sakho lokuhambisa abantu baso nempahla.
target: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.

source: Esinye sezibonelo sakamuva esiphawuleka kakhulu salokhu bekuwumkhankaso waseNyakatho Atlantic weWWII. AmaMelika ayezama ukuyisa abantu nezimpahla ngaphesheya koLwandlekazi i-Atlanti ukusiza iBhrithani.
target: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.

source: Ngesikhathi esifanayo, ibutho lemikhumbi laseJalimane, lisebenzisa ama-U-boat ngokuyinhloko, belizama ukuvimbela lokhu kuhamba.
target: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.

source: Ukube amaZwe Ayelwa neJalimane ayehlulekile, iJalimane cishe belizokwazi ukunqoba iBhrithani njengoba lenze okufanayo ngeYurophu yonke.
target: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.

source: Izimbuzi kubonakala sengathi zenziwa izilwane ezifuywayo okokuqala ngokwesilinganiso eminyakeni engu-10,000 endlule eziNtabeni zase-Zagros e-Iran.
target: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.

source: Amasiko nezizwana zamandulo zaqala ukuzigcina njengendlela elula yokuthola ubisi, izinwele, inyaka, kanye nesikhumba.
target: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.

source: Izimbuzi ezifuywayo ngokuvamile zazigcinwa nomhlambi owawuhamba emagqumeni noma ezindaweni zamadlelo, ngokuphindaphindiwe zazeluswa abelusi ngokuvamile okwakuba izingane noma abasebasha, okungabelusi abafanayo nabaziwayo. Lesi sibonelo sokwalusa sisasentshenziswa nanamuhla.
target: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.

source: Imizila yezinqola yakhiwa eNgilandi kusukela ngeKhulu lama-16 leminyaka.
target: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.

source: Nakuba ama-wagonway bewenziwa izingodo ezugudlene, bezivumela amahhashi azidonsayo ukufinyelela izivinini ezinkulu nokudonsa umthwalo okhudlwana kunasemigwaqweni emibi kancane yangosuku.
target: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.

source: Amapulangi kajantshi cishe enzelwa ukuhlanganisa ujantshi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, nokho, kwabonakala ukuthi ujantshi ungasebenza kangcono uma ungaba nommombo wensimbi ngaphezulu.
target: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.

source: Lokhu kwaba inqubo evamile, kodwa insimbi yayihlikihla amasondo okhuni wezinqola.
target: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.

source: Ekugcineni, amasondo okhuni athathelwa indawo amasondo ensimbi. Ngo-1767, ujantshi wokuqala wensimbi ophelele waqala ukusetshenziswa.
target: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.

source: Indlela yokuqala yokuthatha uhambo eyaziwayo ukuhamba ngezinyawo, abantu baqala ukuhamba beqondile eminyakeni eyizigidi ezimbili edlule ngokuvela kwe-Homo Erectus (okusho umuntu ome waqonda).
target: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).

source: Ababalandela esikhundleni, ama-Australopithecus bawangahambi ngendlela yokuma aqonde ngokujwayelekile.
target: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.

source: Okuchwepheshe ngokuba nyawo-mbili kutholakala emathanjeni aguquke itshe we-Australopithecus kusukela eminyakeni eyizigidi ezingu-4.2-3.9 edlule, nakuba ama-Sahelanthropus kungenzeka ayehamba ngezinyawo ezimbili ngaphambili kakhulu eminyakeni eyizigidi eziyisikhombisa edlule.
target: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.

source: Singaqala ukuphila singoni indawo esizungezile, singajoyina imikhankaso wendawo esizungezile, futhi singaba nangabalweli ukuze sinciphise ukuhlupheka kwesikhathi esizayo ngezinga elithile.
target: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.

source: Kufana nekhambi nje lokwelapha izimpawu zokugula ezimweni eziningi. Nokho, uma singafuni isisombululo sesikhashana, kumelwe sithole umsuka wenkinga bese sinqanda wona.
target: This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them.

source: Kusobala ngokwanele ukuthi umhlaba ushintshe kakhulu ngenxa yokuthuthuka kwabantu kwezesayensi nezobuchwepheshe, futhi izinkinga zibe zinkulu ngenxa yokugcwala kwabantu kanye nempilo yesintu yokuhlaphaza.
target: It is obvious enough that the world has changed much because of humankind's scientific and technological advancements, and problems have become greater because of overpopulation and mankind's extravagant lifestyle.

source: Ngemva kokwamukelwa uKhongolose ngoJulayi 4, isiphakamiso esibhalwe ngesandla sasayinwa uMongameli kaKhongolose uJohn Hancock futhi noNobhala uCharles Thompson wathunyelwa esitolo esiseduzane sokuphrinta sikaJohn Dunlap.
target: After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap.

source: Phakathi nobusuku kwenziwa amakhophi aphakathi kuka-150 no-200, manje aziwa ngokuthi “iDunlap broadsides”.
target: Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as "Dunlap broadsides".

source: Ukufundwa kwedokhumenti kokuqala kwenziwa uJohn Nixon enkundleni ye-Independence Hall ngoJulayi 8.
target: The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8.

source: Eyodwa yathunyelwa kuGeorge Washington ngoJulayi 6, owenza ukuba ifundwelwe amabutho akhe eNew York ngoJulayi 9. Ikhophi yafika eLondon ngo-Agasti 10,
target: One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10.

source: Ukuhlasela ngamazwi okungu-25 kwe-Dunlap okwaziwa ukuthi kukhona amakhophi wedokhumenti akhona amadala kunawo wonke. Ikhophi yasekuqaleni ebhalwe ngesandla ayisekho.
target: The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived.

source: Izazi eziningi zesayensi yemivubukulo namuhla zikholelwa ukuthi iqembu elilodwa lama-dinosaur laqhubeka liphila futhi lisaphila namuhla. Siwabiza ngezinyoni.
target: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and is alive today. We call them birds.

source: Abantu abaningi abazithathi njengama-dinosaur ngoba zinezimpaphe futhi ziyakwazi ukundiza.
target: Many people don't think about them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.

source: Kodwa kunezinto eziningi ngezinyoni ezisafana ne-dinosaur.
target: But there are a lot of things about birds that still look like a dinosaur.

source: Zinezinyawo ezinocwecwe nezinzipho, zibekela amaqanda, futhi zihamba ngezinyawo zazo ezimbili zasemuva njengeT-Rex.
target: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.

source: Cishe wonke amakhompyutha asetshenziswayo namuhla asekelwe ekusebenziseni ukwaziswa okufakwayo endaweni ngezinombolo ezibhangqiwe.
target: Virtually all computers in use today are based on the manipulation of information which is coded in the form of binary numbers.

source: Inombolo enziwe ngeziqu ezimbili ingaba nenani elilodwa kuphela kulawa amabili, okungukuthi u-0 noma u-1, futhi kubhekiselwa kulezinombolo ngokuthi amadijithi aneziqu ezimbili noma – noma ama-bit, uma kusetshenziswa ulimi lwasejele.
target: A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.

source: Ubuthi bangaphakathi kungezeka bungabonakali ngokushesha. Izimpawu, njengokuhlanza zanele ngokuvamile kangangokuthi umhlahlo wokushesha angeke wenziwe.
target: Internal poisoning may not be immediately apparent. Symptoms, such as vomiting are sufficiently general that an immediate diagnosis cannot be made.

source: Isibonakaliso esihle kakhulu soshevu ovela ngaphakathi kungaba ukuba khona kwezitsha zemithi ezivulekile noma amakhemikhali wasendlini anobuthi.
target: The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals.

source: Bheka ilebula ukuze ubone iziqondiso soziso lokuqala zalowo shevu.
target: Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.

source: Igama elithi isilwanyakazane lisetshenziswa izazi zezinambuzane ngendlela esemthethweni yaleli qembu lezi zinambuzane.
target: The term bug is used by entomologists in a formal sense for this group of insects.

source: Leli gama lidabuka ekujwayelaneni kwakudala neziMbungulu, okuyizilwanyana ezizifanelisela ngokuphila ngokudla emzimbeni wabantu.
target: This term derives from ancient familiarity with Bed-bugs, which are insects highly adapted to parasitize humans.

source: Zombili iZimbungulu eziphila ngezinye izinambuzane neZimbungulu ezivamile zihlala esidlekeni, zifanelekele ukuphila esidlekeni noma endaweni yokuhlala yesilwane ezincela igazi laso.
target: Both Assassin-bugs and Bed-bugs are nidicolous, adapted to living in nest or housing of their host.

source: EMelika yonke kunesilinganiso sabantu abawu-400,000 okubikwe ukuthi bane-Multiple Sclerosis(MS), okuyishiya kuyisifo esiholayo sezinzwa kwabasebasha abakhulile nabakhulile abaseminyakeni ephakathi.
target: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults.

source: I-MS isifo esithinta uhlelo lwezinzwa, olwenziwa ubuchopho, umfunkulu kanye nenzwa yokubona.
target: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, the spinal cord and the optic nerve.

source: Ucwaningo lubonise ukuthi abesifazane banamathuba akabili okuba neMS kunabesilisa.
target: Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.

source: Abantu ababili abathandanayo bangabona kungenakubasiza, noma kusize ingane, ukukhulisa ingane.
target: A couple may decide it is not in their best interest, or in the interest of their child, to raise a baby.

source: Le mibhangqwana ingakhetha ukwenza uhlelo lokuthi ingane yabo itholwe abanye.
target: These couples may choose to make an adoption plan for their baby.

source: Ekutholeni ingane enganabazali, abazali abayizalayo balahla amalungelo abo obuzali ukuze omunye umbhangqwana ube abazali bengane.
target: In an adoption, the birth parents terminate their parental rights so that another couple may parent the child.

source: Umngomo oyinhloko wesayensi ukuthola indlela izwe elisebenza ngayo uma lisebenzisa indlela yesayensi. Le ndlela eqinisweni iqondisa oluningi ucwaningo lwesayensi.
target: Science’s main goal is to figure out the way the world works through the scientific method. This method in fact guides most scientific research.

source: Akukodwa nokho, ukulinga, futhi isilingo isivivinyo esisetshenziselwa ukususa ukucabangela okuhle okukodwa noma okwengeziwe, ukubuza imibuzo, nokwenza ukuphawula kanye nokuqondisa ucwaningo olungokwesayensi.
target: It isn’t alone though, experimentation, and an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses, asking questions, and making observations also guide scientific research.

source: Izazi zemvelo kanye nezefilosofi zigxile emibhalweni yamandulo futhi, ngokukhethekile, eBhayibhelini ngesiLatin.
target: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, on the Bible in Latin.

source: Imibono ka-Aristotle yesayensi yamukelwa yonke, kuhlanganise nesayikholoji.
target: Accepted were Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology.

source: Njengoba ulwazi lwaseGrisi lwaluncipha, iNtshonalanga yazithola isuka ezimpandeni zayo zefilosofi nesayensi zobuGriki.
target: As knowledge of Greek declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.

source: Iningi lokuphindaphinda kuyifiziyoloji nasekuziphatheni okubonwayo ngokuvamile kuxhomeke ngokuyinhloko ekubeni khona kwemijikelezo evela phakathi kanye nokwenziwa kwako ngamawashi emvelo.
target: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks.

source: Izigqi zezikhathi ezithile, okungekhona ukusabela nje kwezinkomba ezingaphandle, kubikiwe ezidalweni eziningi eziphilayo, kuhlanganise amabhakithiliya, isikhunta, izitshalo, kanye nezilwane.
target: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.

source: Amawashi endalo azivuselela amandla azoqhubeka esebenza emjikelwezweni okhululekile ngisho noma enkathini ongeke ukwazi ukuyicabanga.
target: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.

source: Isilingo sika-Hershey no-Chase bekungokunye kokusikisela okuhamba phampili kokuthi iDNA isakhi sofuzo.
target: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.

source: U-Hershey noChase basebenzise ama-phages, noma amagciwane, ukuthi bafake i-DNA yabo phakathi kwebhakithiliya.
target: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.

source: Benze izivivinyo ezimbili ngokwenza i-DNA nge-phage besebenzisa iphosphorus ye-radioactive noma amaprotheni e-phage nge-sulfur ye-radioactive.
target: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.

source: Ukuguquka kungaba namathonya ahlukile angafani kuye ngohlobo lokuguquka, ukubaluleka kocezu lwesakhi sofuzo oluthintekile kanye nokuthi amangqamuzana athintekile amangqamuzana esidoda neqanda yini.
target: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.

source: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo emagqamuzaneni wamagciwane kuphela okungadluliselwa ezinganeni, nakuba ukuguquka kwenye indawo kungabangela ukufa kwamangqamuzana noma umdlavuza.
target: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.

source: Izindawo zokuvakasha ezingokwemvelo zikhanga abantu abathanda ukuvakashela izindawo ezingokwemvelo ngenhloso yokujabulela ukubuka indawo, kuhlanganise izitshalo nezilwane zasendle.
target: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.

source: Izibonelo zemisebenzi eyenziwa endaweni zihlanganisa ukuzingela, ukudoba, ukuthatha izithombe, ukubuka izinyoni, kanye nokuvakashela amapaki nokufunda ukwaziswa okumayelana nezinto eziphilayo.
target: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.

source: Isibonelo ukuvakasha, ukuthatha izithombe, kanye nokufunda ngama-orangatan eBorneo.
target: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.

source: Njalo ekuseni, abantu bashiya amadolobha amancane wasemaphandleni ngezimoto ukuze baye ezindaweni zabo zokusebenzela futhi badlulwa abanye indawo yabo yokusebenzela elapho basanda kusuka khona.
target: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.

source: Kuloluhlobo lwesithuthi olunamandla wonke umuntu ngandlelathile uxhumene, futhi usekela uhlelo lokuthutha olusekelwe ezimotweni ezincane.
target: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.

source: Isayensi manje ikhomba ukuthi lokhu kubakhona kwe-carbon kucekele phansi imvelo kusuka kwesinye sezimo sayo esizinzile kakhulu esisekele ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwabantu eminyakeni eyizigidi ezimbili edlule.
target: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.

source: Wonke umuntu uyahlanganyela emphakathini futhi usebenzisa uhlelo lokuthutha. Cishe wonke umuntu uyakhalaza ngohlelo lokuthutha.
target: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.

source: Emazweni athuthukile uyethukela uzwa amazinga afanayo okukhalaza ngekhwalithi yamanzi noma amabhuloho awayo.
target: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.

source: Kungani izinhlelo zokuthutha zibanga ukukhalaza okunjalo, kungani zihluleka zinsuku zonke? Ingabe onjiniyela bezinto zokuthutha abafaneleki? Noma kunokuthile okubaluleke kakhudlwana okwenzekayo yini?
target: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?

source: Ukuhamba kweZimoto ucwaningo lwabashayeli ngabanye nezimoto phakathi kwezindawo ezimbili kanye nokusebenzelana kwazo.
target: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.

source: Ngeshwa, ukucwaninga ukuhamba kwezimoto kunzima ngoba imikhuba yabashayeli angeke ibikezelwe ngokuqiniseka okuphelele.
target: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.

source: Ngenhlanhla, abashayeli bathambekele ekuziphatheni ngendlela ecishe ifane; ngakho ukuminyana kwezimoto kuthambekele ekufaneni futhi cishe kungafanekiswa ngokwezibalo.
target: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.

source: Ukufanisa kangcono ukuhamba kwezimoto, ubudlelwane bumisiwe phakathi kwezici ezintathu eziyinhloko: (1) ukuhamba, (2) ukuminyana, kanye (3) nesivinini.
target: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.

source: Lobu budlelwane buyasiza ekuhleleni, ekuklameni, kanye nasekusebenziseni izakhiwo zasemgwaqweni.
target: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.

source: Izinambuzane kwakuyizilwane zokuqala zokundiza. Ikhono lazo lokundiza lazisiza zigweme izitha kalula ngokwengeziwe futhi zithole ukudla kanye nomana ngokuphumelelayo kakhudlwane.
target: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.

source: Izinambuzane eziningi zisizakala ngokukwazi ukugoqa amaphiko wazo emva komzimba wazo.
target: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.

source: Lokhu kubanika indawo enkudlwana yezindawo ezincane zokucashela izilwane ezizingelayo.
target: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.

source: Namuhla, ukuphela kwezinambuzane ezingakwazi ukugoqa amaphiko wazo izinzekamanzi nosathamanzi.
target: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.

source: Eminyakeni eyizinkulungwane eyedlule, indoda ebizwa ngo-Aristarchus yathi Isimiso sikaNozungezilanga sasizungeza iLanga.
target: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.

source: Abanye abantu babecabanga ukuthi unembile kodwa abantu abaningi babekholelwa okuhlukile; ukuthi Isimo Samapulanethi Sokuzungeza Ilanga sasizungeza uMhlaba, kuhlanganise neLanga (kanye nezinye izinkanyezi).
target: Some people thought he was right but many people believed the opposite; that the Solar System moved around the Earth, including the Sun (and even the other stars).

source: Lokhu kubonakala kunengqondo, ngenxa yokuthi uMhlaba awuzwakali sengathi uyanyakaza, akunjalo?
target: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?

source: UMfula i-Amazon ngumfula wesibili omude nomkhulu kunayo yonke eMhlabeni. Unamanzi aphindwe izikhathi ezingaphezu kuka-8 kunomfula wesibili omkhulu kunayo yonke.
target: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.

source: I-Amazon ibuye ibe umfula obanzi kunayo yonke eMhlabeni, kwezinye izikhathi amamayela ayisithupha ububanzi.
target: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.

source: Amaphesenti angu-20 agcwele amanzi ageleza esuka emifuleni yepulanethi aye ezilwandle asuka e-Amazon.
target: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.

source: Umfula i-Amazon oyinhloko ungama-6,387 km (amamayela angu-3,980). Uqoqa amanzi kusuka emifudlaneni eyizinkulungwane.
target: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.

source: Nakuba ukwakha amaphiramidi ngamatshe kwaqhubeka kwaze kwaba sekupheleni koMbuso Omdala, amaphiramidi aseGaza awakaze adlulwe ngobukhulu kanye nangobuhle bobuchwepheshe ekwakhiweni kwawo.
target: Although pyramid-building in stone continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, the pyramids of Giza were never surpassed in their size and the technical excellence of their construction.

source: Umbuso Omusha eGibhithe lamandulo labamba ongezansi ngezikhumbuzo zabanduleli babo, ezazineminyaka engaphezu kwenkulungwane ubudala ngaleso sikhathi.
target: New Kingdom ancient Egyptians marvelled at their predecessors monuments, which were then well over a thousand year old.

source: Abantu beDolobha lase-Vatican bacishe babe ngu-800. Izwe elizimele elincane kunalo wonke emhlabeni nezwe elinabantu abancane kunabo bonke.
target: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.

source: Idolabha lase-Vatican lisebenzisa imithetho yaseNtaliyane kanye nezilimi ezisemthethweni.
target: Vatican City uses Italian in its legislation and official communications.

source: IsiNtaliyane sibuye sibe ulimi lwansuku zonke olusetshenziswa iningi lalabo abasebenza esifundeni kuyilapho isiLatin sivame ukusebenziswa emikhosini engokwenkolo.
target: Italian is also the everyday language used by most of those who work in the state while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.

source: Zonke izakhamuzi zeDolobha laseVatican zingamaRoma Katolika.
target: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.

source: Abantu babazi ngezakhi zamakhemikhali eziyisisekelo njengegolide, isiliva, kanye nethusi kusukela endulo, njengoba lezi zingatholakala endalweni ngohlobo lwendabuko futhi kulula kakhulu uguzigubha ngamathuluzi wasendulo.
target: People have known about basic chemical elements such as gold, silver, and copper from antiquity, as these can all be discovered in nature in native form and are relatively simple to mine with primitive tools.

source: U-Aristotle, isazi sefilosofi, wayenombono wokuthi zonke izinto zenziwe ingxube yento eyodwa noma ezengeziwe kwezine ezingumsuka wezinto zonke. Bezingumhlaba, amanzi, umoya, kanye nomlilo.
target: Aristotle, a philosopher, theorised that everything is made up of a mixture of one or more of four elements. They were earth, water, air, and fire.

source: Lokhu bekucishe kufane nezigaba ezine zezinto ezikhona (ngesigaba esifanayo): eziqinile, uketshezi, igesi, kanye ne-plasma, nakuba abuye aba nombono wokuthi zingashintsha zibe izinto ezintsha ezakha lokho esikubonayo.
target: This was more like the four states of matter (in the same order): solid, liquid, gas, and plasma, though he also theorised that they change into new substances to form what we see.

source: Ingxubaniso ngokuyisisekelo ingxube yezinsimbi ezimbili noma ngaphezulu. Ungakhohlwa ukuthi kunezakhi eziningi eshadini lezakhi zamakhemikhali.
target: Alloys are basically a mixture of two or more metals. Don't forget that there are many elements on the periodic table.

source: Izakhi ezinjengekhalsiyamu nephothaziyamu zithathwa njengensimbi. Yebo, kunezinye izinsimbi njengesiliva negolide.
target: Elements like calcium and potassium are considered metals. Of course, there are also metals like silver and gold.

source: Ungaba futhi nezidungo ezixutshanisiwe ezihlanganisa amanani amancane ezinto ezingezona ezensimbi njenge-carbon.
target: You can also have alloys that include small amounts of non-metallic elements like carbon.

source: Yonke into Embulungeni yenziwe izakhi. Zonke izakhi zenziwe izinhlayiyana ezincane ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-athomu.
target: Everything in the Universe is made of matter. All matter is made of tiny particles called atoms.

source: Ama-athomu mancane ngokumangalisayo kangangokuba ayizigidi eziyizigidi angalingana kungqi osekugcineni kwalomusho.
target: Atoms are so incredibly tiny that trillions of them could fit into the period at the end of this sentence.

source: Kanjalo, ipenseli yaba umngane wabantu abaningi omuhle uma ivela.
target: Thus, the pencil was a good friend to many people when it came out.

source: Ngokudabukisayo, njengoba izindlela zokubhala ezintsha zivelile, ipenseli inikwe isimo nomsebenzi ophansana.
target: Sadly, as newer methods of writing have emerged, the pencil has been relegated to lesser status and uses.

source: Abantu manje babhala imilayezo ezikrinini zamakhompyutha, bangasadingi ukusondela emshinini wokucija amapensela.
target: People now write messages on computer screens, never having to come close to a sharpener.

source: Umuntu angazibuza ukuthi kuzokwenzekani ngekhibhodi lapho kufika okuthile okusha.
target: One can only wonder what the keyboard will become when something newer comes along.

source: Ibhomu le-fission lisebenza ngohlelo lokuthi lithathe amandla liwahlanganise njenge-nucleus kanye namaprothoni amaningi namanyutroni.
target: The fission bomb works on the principle that it takes energy to put together a nucleus with many protons and neutrons.

source: Kufana nokugingqela ikalishi elisindayo phezulu egqumeni. Ukuhlukanisa i-nucleus futhi bese kukhululwa amanye walawo mandla.
target: Sort of like rolling a heavy cart up a hill. Splitting the nucleus up again then releases some of that energy.

source: Amanye ama-athomu anobuphakathi obuxegayo okusho ukuthi avame ukuphuka lapho eqhikinyezwa kancane noma lapho engaqhikinyezwanga.
target: Some atoms have unstable nuclei which means that they tend to break apart with little or no nudging.

source: INyanga yenziwe ngamatshe kanye nothuli. Ingxenye engaphandle yeNyanga ibizwa ngokuthi uqweqwe.
target: The surface of the Moon is made of rocks and dust. The outer layer of the Moon is called the crust.

source: Ungqimba cishe lungugqinsi olungama-70 km ohlangothini oluseduze kanye nogqinsi olungama-100 km ohlangothini olukude.
target: The crust is about 70 km thick on the near side and 100 km thick on the far side.

source: Lulula ngaphansi kolwandle futhi lungugqinsi ngaphansi kwezinkangala.
target: It is thinner under the maria and thicker under the highlands.

source: Kungenzeka kube nezindawo zasenyangeni eziningi ezimnyama ohlangothini ngoba ungqimba luncane. Bekulula ngodaka olushisayo ukukhuphukela phezulu.
target: There may be more maria on the near side because the crust is thinner. It was easier for lava to rise up to the surface.

source: Imicabango yezizathu zokushintsha kwabantu igxile ezintweni ezishukumisa abantu noma ezithinta izinhliziyo zabo.
target: Content theories are centered on finding what makes people tick or appeals to them.

source: Le mibono isikisela ukuthi abantu banezidingo ezithile kanye/noma izifiso eziye zavalelwa ngaphakathi njengoba zikhulela ekubeni zindala.
target: These theories suggest that people have certain needs and/or desires which have been internalized as they mature to adulthood.

source: Le mibono ihlola ukuthi yini eyenza abanye abantu bafune izinto abazifunayo nokuthi yiziphi izinto endaweni yabo ezizobenza benze noma bangenzi ezinye izinto.
target: These theories look at what it is about certain people that make them want the things that they do and what things in their environment will make them do or not do certain things.

source: Imicabango eshukumisayo emibili ethandwayo yiHierarchy of Needs Theory kaMaslow kanye neTwo Factor Theory kaHertzberg.
target: Two popular content theories are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs Theory and Hertzberg's Two Factor Theory.

source: Ngokukhuluma nje, ukuziphatha okubili kungahlangana njengoba abaphathi beqala ukuhola amawembu ababesebenzisana nabo.. Omunye uzama ukuba “ingxenye yabafana” (noma amantombazane).
target: Generally speaking, two behaviors can emerge as managers begin to lead their former peers. One end of the spectrum is trying to remain “one of the guys” (or gals).

source: Lolu hlobo lwemenenja luba nobunzima uma kufunanele lwenze izinqumo ezingathandeki, ukuqondisa izigwegwe zabasebenzi, ukuhlolwa kokusebenza, ukwabiwa komsebenzi, nokwenza abantu baziphendulele ngokwemisebenzi yabo.
target: This type of manager has difficulty making unpopular decisions, performing disciplinary action, performance evaluations, assigning responsibility, and holding people accountable.

source: Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umuntu uyaguquka abe ngumuntu ongasabonakali ukuthi ungubani ozizwa sengathi kumelwe ashintshe konke obekwenziwa iqembu futhi akwenze okwakhe.
target: At the other end of the spectrum, one morphs into an unrecognizable individual that feels he or she must change everything the team has been doing and make it their own.

source: Ngemva kwakho konke, abaholi ibona abonomthwalo wangempela wemfanelo wokuphumelela nokuhluleka kweqembu.
target: After all, the leader is ultimately responsible for the success and failure of the team.

source: Le ndlela yokuziphatha ezikhathini eziningi libangela ukwahlukana phakathi kwabaholi nethimba lonke.
target: This behavior oftentimes results in rifts between the leaders and the rest of the team.

source: Amaqembu abukeka njengangokoqobo aphathwa ngezimiso ezifanayo zobuhle njengamaqembu angokwesiko, kepha kunomehluko ocashile.
target: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences.

source: Amalungu weqembu wekhompyutha avame ukusebenza njengendawo yokuxhumana yamalungu aseduze kakhulu eqembu elingokoqobo.
target: Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group.

source: Ngokuvamile banenkululeko yokuzimela kakhulu kunamalungu eqembu avamile njengoba amaqembu abo angahlangana ngokuya ngezikhathi zendawo ezihlukene okungenzeka kungaqondwa abaphathi basendaweni.
target: They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management.

source: Ukuba khona “kweqembu elingabonakali” langempela (uLarson noLaFasto, 1989, k109) kubuye kube yisici esikhethekile seqembu ekungelona elingokoqobo.
target: The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team.

source: Iqembu elingabonakali iqembu labaphathi lelo ilungu ngalinye elilandisa kubo. Iqembu elingabonakali libekela ilungu ngalinye izindinganiso.
target: The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.

source: Kungani inhlangano ingafuna ukusebenza ngenqubo edla isikhathi yokumisa inhlangano efundisa amalungu ayo? Umgomo owodwa wokusebenzisa imibono yenhlangano efundisa amalungu ayo amacebo.
target: Why would an organization want to go through the time consuming process of establishing a learning organization? One goal for putting organizational learning concepts into practice is innovation.

source: Uma zonke izinsiza-kusebenza zisetshenziswa ngempumelelo eminyanweni esebenzayo yenhlangano, ukusungula nobuhlakani kungenzeka.
target: When all available resources are effectively used across the functional departments of an organization, creativity and ingenuity can transpire.

source: Ngenxa yalokho, inqubo yokuba inhlangano isebenze ndawonye ukuze inqobe isithiyo ingaholela enqubweni etsha yamacebo okunaka izidingo zekhasimende.
target: As a result, the process of an organization working together to overcome an obstacle can lead to a new innovative process to serve the customer's need.

source: Ngaphambi kokuba inhlangano ibe namacebo, abaholi kumelwe benze isiko lokusungula amacebo kanye nolwazi oluhlanganyelwayo nokufundisa amalungu enhlangano.\
target: Before an organization can be innovative, leadership must create a culture of innovation as well as shared knowledge and organizational learning.

source: U-Angel (2006), uchaza indlela yeContinuum njengendlela esetshenziselwa ukusiza izinhlangano zifinyelele ezingeni eliphakeme lokusebenza.
target: Angel (2006), explains the Continuum approach as a method being used to help organizations reach a higher level of performance.

source: Idatha yesayensi yohlelo lwezinzwa inikeza ukufakazi obungokoqobo bendlela engokomcabango yokuhlola ukucabanga. Ngakho-ke, inciphisa umkhakha wocwaningo futhi iwenze unembe kakhudlwana.
target: Neurobiological data provide physical evidence for a theoretical approach to the investigation of cognition. Therefore it narrows the research area and makes it much more exact.

source: Ukuhlanganiswa ngokuqhathaniswa phakathi kwesayensi yezifo zobuchopho kanye nokuziphatha kusekela ososayensi ocwaningweni lwabo.
target: The correlation between brain pathology and behaviour supports scientists in their research.

source: Kudala kwaziwa ukuthi izinhlobo ezihlukile zokulimala kobuchopho, ukuhlukumezeka, izilonda, kanye nokhwekhwe kuthinta ukuziphatha futhi kubangela ushintsho kokunye kokusebenza kwengqondo.
target: It has been known for a long time that different types of brain damage, traumas, lesions, and tumours affect behaviour and cause changes in some mental functions.

source: Ukuba khona kwezobuchwepheshe ezintsha kusivumela ukuba sibone futhi sihlole ukwakheka kwengqondo kanye nezinqubo ezingakaze zibonwe ngaphambili.
target: The rise of new technologies allows us to see and investigate brain structures and processes never seen before.

source: Lokhu kusinika ukwaziswa okuningi nezinto zokwakha imishini yokulingisa esisiza siqonde indlela zokusebenza kwengqondo.
target: This provides us with a lot of information and material to build simulation models which help us to understand processes in our mind.

source: Nakuba i-AI inomqondo oqinilile wezindaba eziqanjiwe zesayensi, i-AI yenza ingxenye ebalulekile kakhulu yesayensi yamakhompyutha, ebukana nokuziphatha, ukufunda kanye nokusebenza komshini kokuhlakanipha.
target: Although AI has a strong connotation of science fiction, AI forms a very important branch of computer science, dealing with behavior, learning and intelligent adaptation in a machine.

source: Ucwaningo lwezamarobothi luhlanganisa ukwenza imishini yenze ngokuzenzakalekayo imisebenzi edinga ukucabanga komuntu.
target: Research in AI involves making machines to automate tasks that require intelligent behavior.

source: Izibonelo zihlanganisa ukulawula, ukuhlela nokwenza isheduli, ikhono lokuphendula ukubhula nemibuzo yekhasimende, kanye nokuqaphela ngesandla, izwi nobuso.
target: Examples include control, planning and scheduling, the ability to answer customer diagnoses and questions, as well as handwriting recognition, voice and face.

source: Izinto ezinjalo zibe izimiso ezihlukile, ezigxila ekunikezeni izisombululo zezinkinga ezingokoqobo zokuphila.
target: Such things have become separate disciplines, which focus on providing solutions to real life problems.

source: Uhlelo lwe-AI manje ngokuvamile lusetshenziswa emkhakheni wezomnotho, ezokwelapha, ubunjiniyela kanye nempi, njengoba kwakhiwe ezinhlelweni zokusebenza zamakhompyutha wasekhaya amaningana nemidlalo yevidiyo.
target: The AI ​​system is now often used in the fields of economics, medicine, engineering and the military, as has been built in several home computer and video game software applications.

source: Uhambo lwesikole seluyingxenye enkulu yekilasi. Kaningi uthisha angathanda ukuyisa abafundi bakhe ezindaweni lapho kungafikeki khona ngohambo lwebhasi.
target: Field trips are a large part of any classroom. Quite often a teacher would love to take her students places to which a bus trip is not an option.

source: Ezobuchwepheshe zinikeza isisombululo ngohambo lwesikole olubukeka njengolwangempela. Abafunda bangabuka imivubukulo yasemnyuziyamu, bavakashele indawo yokugcina izinhlanzi, noma bajabulele ubuhle bobuciko belokhu behlezi nekilasi labo.
target: Technology offers the solution with virtual field trips. Students can look at museum artifacts, visit an aquarium, or admire beautiful art while sitting with their class.

source: Ukuhlanganyela uhambo lwesikole cishe enye indlela enhle kakhulu yokucabangisisa ohambweni nokwabelana ngokwenzekile namakilasi wesikhathi esizayo.
target: Sharing a field trip virtually is also a great way to reflect a on a trip and share experiences with future classes.

source: Ngokwesibonelo, unyaka ngamunye abafundi abavela eSikoleni saseBennet eNyakatho Carolina baklama iwebhusayithi ngohambo lwabo lokuya Enhlokodolobha Yezwe, unyaka ngamunye amawebhusayithi akhiwa kabusha futhi, kodwa izinhlobo ezindala ziyagcinwa kuyi-inthanethi ukuthi isebenze njengencwadi yokugcina izinto.
target: For example, each year students from Bennet School in North Carolina design a website about their trip to the State Capital, each year the website gets remodeled, but old versions are kept online to serve as a scrapbook.

source: Amabhulogi angasiza abafundi ngokubhala. Nakuba abafundi kaningi baqala umsebenzi wabo wokubhuloga ngendlela yokubhala nokupela yobudlabha, ukuba khona kwezilaleli kaningi kuyakushintsha lokho.
target: Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that.

source: Njengoba abafundi ngokuvamile bayizilaleli ezigxeka kakhulu, umbhali webhulogi uqala ukulwela ukuthuthukisa ukubhala ukuze akweme ukugxekwa.
target: Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism.

source: Futhi ukubhuloga "kuphoqa abafundi ukuba babenokuqonda kakhudlwana ngezwe elibazungezile." Isidingo sokondla isithakazelo sabantu abafundayo kushukumisa abafundi ukuba bahlakaniphe futhi bathakazelise (Toto, 2004).
target: Also blogging "forces students to become more savvy about the world around them." The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004).

source: Ukubhuloga ithuluzi elikhuthaza ukubambisana, futhi likhuthaza abafundi ukuba bangagcini ngokufunda osukwini lwesikole oluvamile.
target: Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day.

source: Indlela efanele yokusebenzisa amabhulogi “inganika abafundi amandla okuba abahlakahlayo nabahlolisisayo kakhudlwana; abafundi bangachaza izikhundla zabo ngomongo wemibhalo yabanye kanye nokusho imibono yabo ngezindaba ezithile (Oravec, 2002).
target: Appropriate use of blogs "can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002).

source: I-Ottawa inhlokodolobha yaseKhanada enhle, enezilimi ezimbili futhi enezikhungo eziningi zobuciko namamnyuziyamu abonisa izinto zaseKhanada zesikhathi esidlule nezamanye.
target: Ottawa is Canada's charming, bilingual capital and features an array of art galleries and museums that showcase Canada's past and present.

source: Kude eningizimu neMpophoma iNiagara nasenyakatho yikhaya elingaphazanyisiwe lobuhle obungokwemvelo beMuskoka nagaphesheya.
target: Farther south is Niagara Falls and the north is home to the untapped natural beauty of the Muskoka and beyond.

source: Zonke lezi zinto nokuningi kugcizelela i-Ontario njengebhekwa njengeyaseKhanada uqobo lwayo abantu bangaphandle.
target: All these things and more highlight Ontario as what is considered quintessentially Canadian by outsiders.

target: Large areas further north are quite sparsely populated and some is nearly uninhabited wilderness.

target: Most of the smaller islands are independent nations, or associated with France, and known as luxury beach resorts.

target: Be firm in turning down men, and don't be afraid to stand your ground (cultural differences or not, it doesn't make it ok!).

source: Idolobha lanamuhla laseCasablanca lasungulwa abadobi baseBerber ngekhulu lama-10 leminyaka BCE, futhi belisetshenziswa abantu baseFenike, eRoma, kanye namaMerenid njengetheku elisendaweni ekahle elibizwa nge-Anfa.
target: The modern city of Casablanca was founded by Berber fishermen in the 10th century BCE, and was used by the Phoenicians, Romans, and the Merenids as a strategic port called Anfa.

source: AmaPutukezi alichitha futhi alakha kabusha ngaphansi kwegama leCAsa Branca, ukuze nje aliyeke dengwane ngemva kokuzamazama komhlaba ngo-1755.
target: The Portuguese destroyed it and rebuilt it under the name Casa Branca, only to abandon it after an earthquake in 1755.

source: Inkosi yaseMorocco yakha kabusha leli dolobha njengeDaru l-Badya futhi lanikezwa igama lokuthi iCasablanca ngabathengisi baseSpeyini abamisa izindawo zokuhweba lapho.
target: The Moroccan sultan rebuilt the city as Daru l-Badya and it was given the name Casablanca by Spanish traders who established trading bases there.

source: ICasablanca enye yezindawo ezingathakazelisi kakhulu yokuthenga kuyo eMorocco yonke.
target: Casablanca is one of the least interesting places to shop in all of Morocco.

source: Eduze neMedina endala kulula ukuthola izindawo ezidayisa izinto ezingokwesiko zase-Morocco, njenge-tagines, izinto zobumba, izinto zesikhumba, amapayipi okubhema, kanye neminikilishwana eminingi yokuhlobisa, kodwa konke okwezivakashi.
target: Around the old Medina it's easy to find places selling traditional Moroccan goods, such as tagines, pottery, leather goods, hookahs, and a whole spectrum of geegaws, but it's all for the tourists.

source: IGoma yidolobha laseDemocratic Republic of Congo elise mpumalanga eduzane naseRwanda eliheha izivakashi.
target: Goma is a tourist city of the Democratic Republic of Congo in the extreme east near Rwanda.

source: Ngo-2002 iGoma yabhujiswa udaka olushisayo oluvela kuyintabamlilo iNyirogongo eyagqiba eminingi yemigwaqo yasedolobheni, ikakhulukazi maphakathi nedolobha.
target: In 2002 Goma was destroyed by lava from the Nyiragongo volcano which buried most of the town’s streets, particularly the town centre.

source: Nakuba iGoma iphephile ngokwezinga elithile, noma ikuphi ukuvakasha ngaphandle kweGoma kumelwe kucwaningwe ukuze uzwisise isimo sokulwa okusesifundazweni saseNyakatho Kivu.
target: While Goma is reasonably safe, any visits outside of Goma should be researched to understand the state of the fighting that persists in the North Kivu province.

source: Idolobha libuye libe isiqu sokugibela intabamlilo iNyiragongo kanye nokunye kokulandelela amaGorila waseNtabeni okubiza kancane kunakho konke e-Afrika.
target: The city is also the base to climb the Nyiragongo volcano along with some of the cheapest Mountain Gorilla tracking in Africa.

source: Uma usebenzisa i-boda-boda (itekisi lesithuthuthu) ukuhambahamba eGoma. Inani elivamile (lasendaweni) u-~500 wama-Franc wase-Congo uma ufuna uhambo olufishane.
target: You can use boda-boda (motorcycle taxi) to get around Goma. The normal (local) price is ~500 Congolese Francs for the short ride.

source: Kuhlanganiswe nokungafinyeleleki kuyo kalula, "iTimbuktu" seyisetshenziswa njengesingathekiso samazwe angajwayelekile, akude.
target: Combined with its relative inaccessibility, "Timbuktu" has come to be used as a metaphor for exotic, distant lands.

source: Namuhla, iTimbuktu idolobha eliphundlekile, nakuba idumela lalo lilenza lithandwe izivakashi, futhi linesikhumulo sezindiza.
target: Today, Timbuktu is an impoverished town, although its reputation makes it a tourist attraction, and it has an airport.

source: Ngo-1990, yafakwa ohlwini lwezindawo zefa lomhlaba ezisengozini, ngenxa yosongo lwesihlabathi sasohlane.
target: In 1990, it was added to the list of world heritage sites in danger, due to the threat of desert sands.

source: Kwakungenye yezindawo zokuma phakathi nohlelo lwePBs lukaHenry Louis Gates lweZimangaliso Zezwe lase-Afrika.
target: It was one of the major stops during Henry Louis Gates' PBS special Wonders of the African World.

source: Idolobha lihlukile ngokuphelele kwamanye amadolobha ezwe, ngoba linomoya wase-Arabhiya kakhulu ukudlula owaseAfrika.
target: The city is in stark contrast to the rest of the country's cities, because it has more of an Arabic flair than of an African.

source: IKruger National Park (KNP) isenyakatho-mpumalanga yaseNingizimu Afrika futhi ihamba ngasemngceleni weMozambique empumalanga, iZimbabwe enyakatho, futhi umngcele ongaseningizimu iCrocodile River.
target: The Kruger National Park (KNP) lies in the north-east of South Africa and runs along the border of Mozambique in the east, Zimbabwe in the north, and the southern border is the Crocodile River.

source: Ubukhulu bepaki bungu-19,500 km² futhi lihlukaniswe laba yizindawo ezingokwemvelo ezingu-14, ngayinye inezidalwa zasendle ezihlukahlukene.
target: The park covers 19,500 km² and is divided in 14 different ecozones, each supporting different wildlife.

source: Ingenye yezindawo ezivakashelwa kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika futhi ithathwa njengendawo eyaziwa kakhulu kumaPaki weZwe waseNingizimu Afrika (SANParks).
target: It is one of the main attractions of South Africa and it is considered the flagship of South African National Parks (SANParks).

source: Njengawo wonke amaPaki Wezwe waseNingizimu Afrika, kunamanani okuhlanga ngaphakathi usuku ngalunye kanye namanani okungena wepaki.
target: As with all South African National Parks, there are daily conservation and entry fees for the park.

source: Kungabuye kuzuzise ukuba umuntu athenge iWild Card, elimvumela ukungena kwelinye lamapaki okungakhethwa kuwo waseNingizimu Afrika noma wonke amaPaki Wezwe waseNingizimu Afrika.
target: It may also be beneficial for one to buy a Wild Card, which provides entry to either selections of parks in South Africa or all of the South African National Parks.

source: Isiqhingi saseHong Kong sinika indawo yaseHong Kong igama layo futhi yindawo leyo izivakashi eziningi eziyithatha njengendawo yokuvakashelwa eyinhloko.
target: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus.

source: Ipharedi yamabhilidi enza umugqa wesibhakabhaka sase-Hong Kong ifaniswe neshadi lebha elikhazimulayo elibonakala ngokuba khona kwamanzi ase-Victoria Harbour.
target: The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour.

source: Ukuze ube nemibono emihle kakhulu ye-Hong Kong, shiya lesi siqhingi uye echibini lamanzi lase-Kowloon eliqondene.
target: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.

source: Iningi kokuthuthuka kwase-Hong Kong Island kugcwele ezweni elisanda kubuyiswa futhi ogwini olusenyakatho.
target: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.

source: Le indawo abenzi bamakoloni baseBrithani abayithatha njengendawo yabo ngakho uma ufuna ukubona ubufakazi besikhathi esedlule sobukoloni salendawo, lena indawo efanele ongaqala kuyo.
target: This is the place the British colonisers took as their own and so if you are looking for evidence of the territory's colonial past, this is a good place to start.
